skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic concepts of development investment and investment projects; grasp the research procedures and organization of project design.
Master the methods and criteria for evaluating the financial and socio-economic effectiveness of investment projects.
Develop skills in analyzing and drafting specific investment projects, and in selecting optimal investment options.
Understand the social context and adapt to globalization, have social responsibility and abide by regulations and laws.
Demonstrate the ability to work independently and collaboratively, with a spirit of cooperation and responsibility.
